title: Jutsu Upkeep
body:
Syntax: help jutsu upkeep

Description: Active Sharingan, Sage Mode, Shadow Clones, Track, Kamui Pocket Dimension, and Samurai Sabre pay their normal resource costs at each upkeep tick. Their Chakra and Stamina costs are combined into one report every six minutes, with each ability listed separately. Turning off an ability or running out of resources reports its pending cost immediately. Learned jutsu with paid maintenance have a chance to gain 1% mastery for each ten seconds actively maintained, even outside combat; this chance falls as mastery rises and never exceeds 100%. Sharingan uses its own bloodline mastery progression, while Sage Mode mastery comes from training with its elder.

Date: 2026-09-27
